title: German Registry for Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Interventions
brief_summary: Multicentre observational study of patients with severe tricuspid regurgitation and interventional treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Interventional treatment of severe tricuspid regurgitation (isolated or in combination with another interventional treatment) with a CE certified product for tricuspid valve repair
* Informed consent corresponding to criteria of Good Clinical Practice and the decleration of Helsinki as well as to standards of the local ethic commission.

Exclusion Criteria:

* No agreement to participation
* Age \< 18 years
study_population: Patients with severe symptomatic tricuspid regurgitation, who are not eligible for cardiac surgery due to a high risk of mortality.
